changes: Fog pipeline links use native OT_TYPE/getaddr/getlen/addPrim rather than PS1 24-bit addresses.

Original s12c callback at 0x800D4B5C loads a color pointer from the first packet color field before dereferencing it, as reflected by the recovered C; this behavior was checked in the original code.
s11e initialized data is defined with array/vector types; every recovered initialized word was checked against the original overlay before conversion.
s11e and s11i commanders use their recovered structure types with original 0x124/0x144 size assertions, preserving state as one object.
s11e callback table uses the original-address-confirmed sound, breath, sight and bullet functions; the unused breath argument is removed to match the one-argument call contract.
s11e and s11i item-message tables reference verified native strings instead of original PS1 addresses.
GCL string and argv types, pad-vibration byte arrays, native RotTransPers parameters, and signed 16-bit literal representation match declared interfaces.
